description: Urban Waste Water Agglomerations Failing to meet EU Sewage Treatment Standards is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environmental Protection Agency. This shows all urban areas that failed to comply with one or more of the EU sewage treatment standards. Further information about urban areas failing to meet EU sewage treatment standards and information on the Directive can be found in the EPA’s Annual Urban Waste Water Report on the EPA website www.epa.ie. Coverage: Ireland. The portal files it under the publisher Environmental Protection Agency. Its tags are environment, government, ie, industrial waste, plant locations. It offers 3 resource(s) in HTML, JSON, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
